system.description: A bone of one of Harkin's saints, wrapped in grave-silk. Once per day, when you roll on the Death's Door table, roll twice and choose. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈ Within 1 minute of a creature's death, grind the bone over the body: it returns to life at 1 HP, unconscious, and is Doomed.
system.drawback: You are Doomed until it is recovered.
system.faction: the Silent Fraternity of the Cairn
